UPSTREAM: Revert "soc/amd/stoneyridge/gpio: Configure debounce for irq gpios" This reverts commit b82afce18aff24b6e5e3b73a67a6533cc4865a26. Reason for revert: This causes depthcharge to not boot due to TPM timeout errors. Because there is no wait after setting the debounce register, we lose data because the read-modify-write loses the interrupt status bit. e.g., GPIO 5 sets debounce, without a wait. Then GPIO 9 has it's debounce set. Because the interrupt controller is masking the interrupt enable status bit, the read-modify-write for GPIO9 loses the interrupt enable status bit and it never gets set again. This causes the interrupt to never latch. We should possibly make depthcharge set the interrupt enable status bit for latched GPIOs. BUG=none BRANCH=none TEST=none Change-Id: I41eb5df3a9e09ab97ccdb1fc0a00fb85c654c6ba Signed-off-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@google.com> Original-Commit-Id: 034e5e6fa5499e52c51097047a8896da734e08ea Original-Change-Id: Idd7259b14b24c441529d64e173be9faec03f4fc8 Original-Signed-off-by: Raul E Rangel <rrangel@chromium.org> Original-Signed-off-by: Martin Roth <martinroth@google.com> Original-Reviewed-on: https://review.coreboot.org/c/30981 Original-Tested-by: build bot (Jenkins) <no-reply@coreboot.org> Original-Reviewed-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1425311 Commit-Ready: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org> Tested-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org>

tast: Stop installing runtime dependencies. Update the Portage commands that "tast run -build=true" uses to list and install missing dependencies. Instead of listing all immediate dependencies using emerge, querying each in parallel, and then printing an emerge command that installs each of them, run a single emerge command that finds all missing dependencies and print a second emerge command to install them. The new approach is slightly slower, but it checks the entire dependency tree rather than just immediate dependencies and lets us ignore runtime dependencies specified via RDEPEND. common-mk: Make mojom_bindings_generator script injectable. In mojom_bindings_generator.gni, the script path is hard coded pointing to the /usr/src/libmojo-*/ directory, which is installed by libmojo package. For the libchrome/libmojo migration, this script is reused to build libchrome/libmojo itself, so the script is not yet installed at that timing. This CL introduces the variable |mojom_bindings_generator| and use it if defined by the invoker. Also, the generated files will be compiled with libmojo, so the static library is not needed for the case. To support it, this CL splits the template into two, generate_mojom_bindings_gen, and generate_mojom_bindings. Several variables and rules are moved around along with this change. BUG=chromium:910002 TEST=Build.
